text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I lost again! My comeback was
unsuccessful,
ineffectual—a total bust...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I know I shouldn't be saying things like that, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm pathetic...
I failed to spread my wings
yet
again...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué? What do you mean? How can I
take it easy
at a time like this?!
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy for once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road of a champion is full of thorns
and
spikes. Getting through it with force
alone will
make you burn out midway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why taking time to rest and
reflect on how
you brave that road is
essential.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Just giving it my all isn't gonna cut
it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Good thinking! I'm starting to feel like I
can win
next time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sí! I'm gonna go the distance on my
victory road!
choice_data_list: We're going to make steady progress!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sí. No matter how many times I fall, I'll
keep
gettin' back up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm... the Phantom Bird!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And this Phantom Bird is immortal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Claro! This time, I'm takin' on the world!
choice_data_list: Show 'em what you've got, El Condo...
